title: SQLite knowledge graph store
tests_passed: 753 full CRIBA tests passed; 1 pre-existing dependency deprecation warning
decisions: The graph store reuses the isolated IntelligenceStore schema instead of introducing a duplicate graph database.
Node updates use SQLite ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE so existing relations are preserved.
Edges are idempotent by (src, dst, relation); shortest_path traverses directed edges while neighbors reports both endpoints.
NetworkX and Neo4j remain outside the critical path.
risks: The graph store composes the existing IntelligenceStore connection through its internal connection attribute; a future storage facade could make that boundary public.
Graph persistence uses the existing schema version 1; repeated node and edge upserts merge source_doc_ids, as verified by P06-T09.
follow_up: BF-P00-T06 golden validation in an isolated copy; do not overwrite live tracked artifacts
